title: play_attachment
description: The active player plays an attachment during an action window and attaches it to a card in play (a character of any player, or a province). From their hand, or from elsewhere when a card allows it (Guidance of the Ancestors, Kunshu, Infiltrator…): an attachment of a hand, a conflict deck (a card looked at) or a conflict discard pile, of any player. The player controls the attachment, whoever owns it. The player says what they pay (`card_cost`), since card effects may modify costs. The player resolves what follows with other actions, then ends their action (`end_resolution`), which ends their opportunity to act.

card_id.description: Attachment played: in a hand, a conflict deck or a conflict discard pile.

target_card_id.description: Character in play or province the attachment goes on.
